hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '-snapshots/' && echo 'BLOCK: Snapshot files should be updated via CI workflow_dispatch, not edited directly' && exit 1 || exit 0

echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.spec\.tsx?$' && npx nx test root -- --testPathPattern="$(basename "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | sed 's/\.spec\.tsx$//' | sed 's/\.spec\.ts$//')" --no-coverage 2>/dev/null || true
